title: KRN-11 and lanes.md agree on who closes a task in a lane PR, and the lane brief prints it
body:
Why: KRN-11 (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) says workers MUST NOT mutate tracker state, while .agents/skills/krn-lead/lanes.md line 7 tells lanes to close their task inside the worktree, and CI task check rejects a Ticket trailer on an open task. The lead brief followed KRN-11 ("do not close"), so lanes #826 and #827 hit red Checks (exit 74) and diverged (one closed, one switched to Refs).
Outcome: one rule: the lane closes its task record in its own PR with Ticket, or the brief generator states it; KRN-11 and lanes.md agree; `krn lane brief` prints the closure line for the given task.
Proof: a rules test asserts KRN-11 text and lanes.md agree on who closes in a lane PR; the brief output names the close command.
